title: The AI media landscape: 71% of AI deals made with media outlets in anglophone countries
why_it_matters_hint: A report, relayed by the free-expression network IFEX, finds AI companies' content deals concentrated on English-language media.
notes: IFEX returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) twice; Google News searches found no other outlet carrying the same report. Headline only; the original report's author is unknown.
